note: Default local model catalog (also termux-bridge/model_catalog.json; both copies must stay identical). Sizes come from the Hugging Face API. scripts/verify_model_catalog.py checks every entry against the Hub and fills missing SHA-256 checksums (CI does that on push); entries without a checksum are only checked by their GGUF header.
